item.title: Pale Waves and Reading’s hottest new acts talk festival antics, their kit must-haves and songwriting secrets
item.description: What we learnt at Reading Festival 2025 - we caught up with some of the most exciting, viral and critically-acclaimed names in pop, indie and rock right now: Pale Waves, Nieve Ella, Antony Szmierek, Nxdia, and Del Water Gap. Between bottles of bubbly, vintage chorus pedals, and bizarre warm-up rituals, they opened up about the tools and quirks that keep their shows running and their next viral hits coming - from guitars, to mic essentials and boxes of Minions. item.title: Watford Colosseum reopens with Ocean Colour Scene headline performance
item.description: Watford Colosseum officially reopened its doors on Friday 29 August, welcoming fans back with a powerhouse performance from Ocean Colour Scene and marking the start of a new era for the historic venue. The 40,000 sq ft space, now managed by AEG Presents on behalf of Watford Borough Council, has undergone a multi-million-pound refurbishment designed to combine state-of-the-art technical upgrades with careful heritage preservation. item.title: Epiphone Unveils Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom
item.description: Epiphone has announced the release of the Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom, a meticulous recreation of Joe Bonamassa’s famed “Black Beauty” — his rare 1959 Gibson Les Paul Custom guitar. Developed in close collaboration with the blues-rock virtuoso himself, the new model celebrates one of Bonamassa’s most cherished instruments while bringing vintage character to a modern audience. item.title: PhantomFocus and ATC at Nashville’s Canyon Studios East
item.description: Don Miggs' Canyon Studios East has recently renovated its facility featuring the PhantomFocus™ System (PFS) monitor tuning protocol and ATC monitors in both its A & B PhantomFocus MixRooms. item.title: JBL VTX and Crown power Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
item.description: For more than two decades, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony has relied on a consistent audio philosophy: high-impact musical delivery combined with uncompromising speech intelligibility. That approach continued in 2025, as a full JBL Professional VTX system, powered by Crown Audio, supported the five-hour live ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. item.title: Audio-Technica ATH-R70xa receives TEC Award Recognition at NAMM 2026
item.description: Audio-Technica’s ATH-R70xa open-back reference headphones have been honoured with a Technical Excellence and Creativity Award in the Headphone and Earpiece Technology category at the 41st Annual TEC Awards, presented during the 2026 NAMM Show in Anaheim, California. item.title: Tommy Torres highlights the importance of honest monitoring in music production
item.description: Latin Grammy-winning producer and songwriter Tommy Torres has spoken about the importance of accurate monitoring and midrange clarity in his creative workflow, citing KRK studio monitors as a key component of his Miami-based production setup. The post Tommy Torres highlights the importance of honest monitoring in music production appeared first on Audio Media International.

item.title: DALI Showcases THX Certified Dominus SUB V-16 F at ISE 2026
item.description: Danish loudspeaker manufacturer DALI is present at Integrated Systems Europe (ISE) 2026 in Barcelona to spotlight its most powerful subwoofer to date, the SUB V-16 F, marking its official show debut as a THX Certified Dominus product. The certification represents the highest performance tier within the THX programme and signals DALI’s first collaboration with the organisation. The post DALI Showcases THX Certified Dominus SUB V-16 F at ISE 2026 appeared first on Audio Media International.

item.title: Source-Connect 4 Becomes First metadata-connected Dolby® Atmos remote review & approval tool
item.description: Source Elements have announced that Source-Connect 4 has become the industry's first remote collaboration solution to achieve Dolby Atmos certification with metadata connection to the Dolby Atmos Renderer. With 128 audio streaming channels supporting any combination of beds and objects—plus full metadata integration—the update connects immersive environments like never before. item.title: The Ivors Academy launches formal presence in Ireland: The Edge speaks…
item.description: The Ivors Academy launches formal presence in Ireland with Catherine Martin to lead policy The Ivors Academy has announced the launch of The Ivors Academy in Ireland, marking its first formal presence outside the UK in more than 80 years. The move establishes a dedicated home for songwriters and composers across the entire island of Ireland, with a focus on protection, empowerment and celebration of music writers at every stage of their careers.
